nights.en: Somang watched the lights of {fest} from the edge of the village square in Ombos.

nights.en: Somang helped prepare {fest} in Ombos; the neighbours knew her work and pulled her into the singing that night.

nights.ko: 잊지 못할 축제의 밤. 음식도, 장식도, 제물도 소망 손을 거쳤다. 광장은 새벽까지 비지 않았다.
nights.en: Somang's food, decorations and offering were all part of {fest} in Ombos, and the village square stayed full until dawn.
